page.title: Package
page.intro: A ready trip a quote starts from, and, once published, a page for visitors with a form that lands in your leads.
page.notFound: This package isn't here any more.

list.title: Packages
list.intro: Your ready trips. A lead's New quote starts from any of them in one tap, and the AI sells the ones you let it.
list.none: No packages yet. Choose New package, or save a quote as one.
list.summary: {days, plural, =0 {No days} one {# day} other {# days}} · {price} before GST
list.summaryTiers: {days, plural, =0 {No days} one {# day} other {# days}} · {tiers, plural, one {# tier} other {# tiers}}
list.summaryFrom: {nights, plural, =0 {Custom trip} one {Custom trip · # night} other {Custom trip · # nights}} · From {price}
list.summaryCustom: {nights, plural, =0 {Custom trip} one {Custom trip · # night} other {Custom trip · # nights}}
list.summaryGroup: {nights, plural, =0 {Group trip} one {Group trip · # night} other {Group trip · # nights}} · {departures, plural, =0 {no departures ahead} one {# departure ahead} other {# departures ahead}}
list.deleteDescription: Quotes made from it stay as they are.

create.title: New package
create.description: Name it and choose its kind. You add its prices, dates and files on its own page next.
create.name: Package name
create.nameHint: What your team calls it, such as Manali 5 days.

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: What your team calls it, such as Kedarnath 6 days.
form.title: Title on a quote
form.titleHint: The quote's title, which the customer reads.
form.destinationHint: Visitors can filter by it, and a lead from the page gets it.
form.nightsHint: Counts the nights of a hotel line when a quote is made.
form.levelHint: For a booking made from this package. Leave on the agency's usual level unless the trip needs more.

levels.detailed: Plus emergency contact and medical notes

form.notesHint: Printed on a quote made from this package.
form.slugHint: The last part of the page's address: /a/{code}/ and this. Lower-case words joined by hyphens.
form.summaryHint: One or two sentences a visitor reads first. Needed to publish.
form.highlightsHint: One short line each, up to ten.
form.fromPriceHint: What you type is shown. It never changes by itself.
form.calculated: {price} each, for the {tier} tier, in the season from {day}.
form.calculateNone: No tier prices completely from the rates yet.
form.cancellationNotesHint: Shown on the page and printed on a quote made from this package.

problems.slug: Use lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.

kinds.custom: A custom trip, quoted for each customer
kinds.group: A group trip that departs on set dates

form.departureMonthsHint: Leave all off for every month.
form.advancePerPerson: Advance to hold a seat (each person)
form.advanceOnlyOnSale: This is the only trip the AI agent can sell: without an advance it stops answering every chat until one is back.
form.pickupPointsHint: Where the group boards, one a line.

tiers.title: Tiers
tiers.intro: Standard, Deluxe: each tier is a set of priced lines. A quote made from this package gets one option for each tier you choose.
tiers.none: No tiers. A quote made from this package starts from the {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} it was saved with.
tiers.removeDescription: Quotes already made from it keep their prices.

tier.description: The lines of one tier. Rates are looked up for a quote's start date when it is made; a line with no rate for those dates becomes a line that needs a rate.
tier.name: Name
tier.descriptionHint: What the customer reads on the quote, such as Hotel in Guptkashi.

rules.per_room_night: One for each room night (rooms are the travellers over two)

tier.priceHint: Left empty, the line needs a rate or a price when a quote is made.
tier.rateHint: Priced from the same item in the season covering the quote's start date.
tier.noRatePermission: Choosing a rate needs permission to see margins.

photos.title: Photos
photos.intro: Up to {max} pictures. The first is the page's picture when its address is shared.
photos.none: No photos yet. A page needs one.

publish.title: Public page
publish.pagesOff: The agency's pages are off, so nothing here is visible yet.
publish.managerOnly: Whoever manages settings publishes the page.

settings.title: Public package pages
settings.intro: Visitors open a package at your agency's own address and send an enquiry that lands in your leads. Each package is published on its own page.
settings.onHint: Published packages are visible to anyone with the link.
settings.aboutHint: A few words shown on every page.
settings.instagramHint: An https address. Leave empty for none.

sell.title: Let the AI sell it
sell.label: AI can sell this package
sell.on: The AI may offer this package to customers.
sell.off: The AI does not offer this package.
sell.needs: Before the AI can sell it, it needs:

gaps.prices: A price for each room type in a season
gaps.advance: The advance to hold a seat
gaps.departures: Departure days and seats on each

sell.nowOn: The AI can sell this package
sell.nowOff: The AI no longer sells this package
sell.stillNeeds: The AI will not sell this package until this is fixed:
sell.managerOnly: Whoever manages settings lets the AI sell a package.

seasons.title: Seasons and room prices
seasons.intro: The price per person of each room type, for the dates a season covers. A booking is priced from the season of its first day.
seasons.none: No seasons yet. Add one to give the room types a price.
seasons.removeDescription: Bookings already made keep their price. New ones on these dates are no longer priced from it.
seasons.noRoomTypes: Choose the room types sold first, in the form on the left.

season.description: The dates, and the price per person of each room type sold, {gst, select, including {including GST} other {before GST}}.
season.label: Name

problems.noPrice: Give at least one room type a price.

packageDepartures.title: Departures
packageDepartures.intro: The next batches of this trip, with the seats left. The weekly days make most of them; add a one-off date here.
packageDepartures.none: No departures of this package yet.

files.title: Brochures
files.intro: Up to {max} brochures (PDF or a picture, 10 MB each). The AI shares them with customers who ask for details.
files.removeDescription: Customers will no longer be sent this file.

problems.wrongType: Choose a PDF or a picture (JPEG, PNG or WebP).
problems.tooLarge: Choose a file of up to {size}.
